actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Thick dark-brown swept-back parted hair with raised top, strong brows, clean stern closed face and near-front leftward pose remain. Dark blue-gray civilian jacket, blue/teal pointed shirt collar and dark tie preserved, without invented cap, glasses or facial hair. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Source remains Chinese CCP related archive-only, prohibited from final mod payload; its art gap is not a release blocker. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.

finite_alpha_support.boundary: Finite numeric support only; actual full image/source/white/cyan comparison supplies visual approval. Exterior alpha zero is expected. No global threshold acceptance.
